主要内容: This document is a Form 6-K filing by Brookfield Asset Management Inc. dated March 31, 2015, submitted to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The filing includes a report of a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 for the month of March 2015. The registrant is filing under Form 40-F, and the document includes an exhibit index. The filing is signed by A.J. Silber, Corporate Secretary of Brookfield Asset Management Inc. The document is part of the company's regulatory filings and provides information about the company's compliance with U.S. securities laws.
